name: buninu-linux
description: A Linux distribution running Bun as PID 1 with the Buninu userspace.
author: Dr. John (醫者小智)

scripts.check: for f in ./index.js ./initramfs/init.js ./initramfs/lib/dlopen.js ./initramfs/lib/modprobe.js ./initramfs/lib/power.js ./initramfs/bin/mount ./initramfs/bin/umount ./initramfs/bin/ip ./initramfs/bin/poweroff ./initramfs/bin/reboot; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
